recommendations.body: `tests/cli/test_roadmap_cmd.py` (step 6 "Show the current stack…") covers the five print sites only by counting call strings in the source of `roadmap_cmd.py`. The autouse fixture `_silence_stack_callout_except_for_its_own_tests` stubs the callout out of every other test. No test shows each of proposal, review, answer, structural approve, and edit/reject printing the callout after `narrative evidence:`. No test shows a callout failure leaving a command's return code at its no-callout baseline. No test shows structural approve keeping its digest and codes with a stack-bearing candidate.
recommendations.suggested_action: add the parametrized per-site output test and the return-code-baseline and approve-digest tests from the detail's `## Tests` to `tests/cli/test_roadmap_cmd.py`, with the callout un-stubbed
